_comment: Configuration for the CredPilot requirements-validation suite.
This file configures HOW the suite reaches the implementation. It must never be used
to weaken a requirement expectation: there is no setting here that can turn a FAIL
implementation_root: where the CredPilot implementation lives. null means 'the parent
directory of requirements_validation_tests'. A relative path is resolved against the
suite root. Overridden by the CREDPILOT_ROOT environment variable, and by --target.
runtime.enabled: whether the suite may execute the implementation's own documented
command to perform black-box checks. With this false, the runtime checks report FAIL
with the reason 'runtime execution disabled' rather than silently passing.
runtime.run_command / traces_command / eval_command: normally left empty. The suite
DISCOVERS these from the implementation's README.md, because the source document
requires a single documented command and a local-run runbook. Set one here only when
an operator needs to point the harness at a command the README does not yet document;
doing so does not excuse the README requirement, which is tested separately.
